developer_context.problem_scenario: An HTTP endpoint transmits a streaming or chunked message payload.
developer_context.observable_behavior: HTTP response entity validation headers (ETags) are erroneously omitted when chunked transfer encoding headers are configured.
developer_context.expected_outcome: The HTTP response payload generator should correctly construct and assign headers according to HTTP caching specifications.
developer_context.environmental_context: HTTP response payload generation and header finalization.
